x: Bob Taylor was also down as a reserve for the 880 yards, but here again the two first strings, Day and Hewson, turned out, so Bob was not called upon to run.
Day was 2nd in the High Jump, with C.

Dennis Fleming had an operation on his arm during the winter but should soon be back in form. Young Day is jumping well and we are pleased to see him when on leave. Other new members are beginning to take their place in teams.
But come off it did, for Jack handed over in third place--behind Roath (Walton) and Day (Ponders End). Eleventh was Eric Gebbett for the 'B' team.
